$Comment: A Burning Grave Candle, what the Gravekeeper burns to open the Headless Horseman's hard ride (Hallows_Eve_Graveyard_Hard.json's EntryCost). Requires opens it once Old Jack counts the player a Regular (Friendly with Old Jack's Favor); a locked offer still shows on the shelf with its lock line, so a player can see what to work towards. No purchase limit and no rotation. SortOrder 7 puts it after the two plain Grave Candle offers on the lanterns shelf, and the same candle for Life Essence (Hallows_Eve_Offer_Burning_Grave_Candle_Life_Essence.json, SortOrder 8, behind the same lock) sits straight after it where the bounty pack runs. Cost is the price in Hallow Sweets. Named by the item's own keys.
